info.name: Clinical Co-Pilot API
info.description: Runnable collection for the Clinical Co-Pilot sidecar. Week 1: /health, /ready, /chat (free-text, chip, authz-denial). Week 2: /ingest (document upload), the document viewer (/documents/{id}/meta, /page/{n}.png, /citations), /metrics/summary, and the full 'what changed?' chat flow. Auth is a short-lived OpenEMR-minted session token (the reusable bearer was revoked): GET {{baseUrl}}/dev/token (dev-mode only) and set {{token}}, or paste a token from the OpenEMR Co-Pilot panel. Set baseUrl, token, documentId. Bruno is the primary collection; this Postman v2.1 export is an equivalent convenience.

request.description: Liveness probe. 200 {"status":"alive"} whenever the process is up. No auth, no dependency checks.
Readiness probe. Pings database + llm + observability. 200 only when all healthy, else 503 with a per-check breakdown.
Free-text turn, Showcase A (pid 101). Expect a source-attributed briefing (form_encounter / prescriptions / procedure_result PKs), the Metformin divergence, and the A1c trend.
Chip turn, Showcase B (pid 102). Expect care-gap items plus constraint_flags: penicillin<->amoxicillin allergy interaction and warfarin+ibuprofen drug-drug pair.
Denial fixture. pid 23 belongs to a different provider; the Authorization Gateway returns 403 AuthzDenied before any read.

exec: // Capture document_id so the viewer requests (07-09) can use it.
try { var b = pm.response.json(); if (b.document_id) pm.collectionVariables.set('documentId', b.document_id); } catch (e) {}

request.description: Week 2 document ingestion (multipart: pid, doc_type, file). Requires COPILOT_INGEST_ENABLED=true and the seeded copilot schema. Returns IngestResult { status, document_id, persisted[] citations, gaps[] (stated in words), needs_review[], field counts }. Fail-closed: an unverified value is a gap, never persisted. Re-run = deduplicated=true, zero new rows. In Postman, set the file field's src to your local copilot/tests/ingest/fixtures/demo_lab_delgado.pdf. The test script stores document_id into the documentId variable.
DocumentMeta { document_id, pid, mimetype, page_count, pages[] } for the overlay viewer. pid required; document<->patient ownership re-checked every call (404 for the wrong patient).
Server-rendered (pypdfium2) page image for the bbox overlay, LRU-cached. Ownership check runs BEFORE the cache is consulted every request. Response is image/png bytes.

Persisted provenance: one DocumentRef per verified field (page + field_id + bbox + verbatim quote) — the click-to-source targets. Only verified fields appear; a failed-verification field is a gap, not a citation.

PHI-free counters behind /dashboard: endpoints (count/errors/p50/p95), turns, nodes (per graph node), routing, ingestion (field_pass_rate), retrieval (hit_rate/degraded), evals. Route templates + enums only; no PHI. Bearer-protected.

Full Week 2 chat flow — run 06 (ingest) first. The uploaded document's verified facts now appear as cited chart rows in briefing[]; handoffs[] shows the supervisor -> worker -> answerer trail; guideline_evidence[] holds gl:-only claims kept separate from the patient briefing; degraded/notes flag any fallback. Identity is pinned server-side; the client only chooses pid.

request.description: Week 2 third document type: medication list (multipart: pid, doc_type=medication_list, file). Verified rows persist to lists (type='medication') — NEVER prescriptions: a document-reported med carries no prescriber authority. Expect 5 rows for this fixture (Glipizide Discontinued -> activity=0; Aspirin's missing frequency surfaced under gaps as not_found). persisted[] pairs a lists SourceRef with a DocumentRef (page + verbatim row quote + text-layer bbox) per med. Re-run = deduplicated=true, zero new rows. In Postman, set the file field's src to your local copilot/tests/ingest/fixtures/demo_medlist_delgado.pdf. The test script stores document_id into the documentId variable.

Deterministic lab-trend series for the chart widget (T5) - no-LLM sibling of /snapshot. series maps test name -> points sorted ASC by date; every point is a full LabResult citing its procedure_result PK. Optional test filter is applied server-side and echoed back. Same token binding + per-patient scope as /snapshot; a labs failure degrades to 200 + empty series + notes, never a 500.
